documentation.file_docstring:
Tests for CrewAI adapter tool-level interception.

Verifies that individual tool calls within a CrewAI crew are validated
against governance policy (allowed_tools, blocked_patterns, max_tool_calls).
inline_comments: Call the wrapped tool to verify it passes
Original _run should have been called (via governed wrapper)
post_execute in kickoff increments call_count by 1,
With the base pre_execute check, kickoff is blocked immediately
post_execute in kickoff uses 1 call, so budget = 4 - 1 = 3 tool calls
member_docstrings: TestCrewAIToolInterception: Test per-tool-call governance in CrewAI adapter.
_make_agent: Create a mock CrewAI agent with tools.
test_allowed_tool_passes: Tool on the allowlist should execute normally.
test_blocked_tool_raises: Tool NOT on the allowlist should be blocked.
test_blocked_pattern_in_args: Tool args matching blocked pattern should be rejected.
test_max_tool_calls_enforced: Should block after max_tool_calls reached.
test_multiple_tools_on_same_agent: All tools on an agent should be wrapped.
test_tools_across_multiple_agents: Tools on all agents in a crew should be governed.
